title: The BEST location for Street Photography in Philadelphia (2024)

mentions.place: City Hall tunnels (pedestrian archways through Philadelphia City Hall, Broad & Market)
mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: wanted to share my favorite place to practice street photography in Philadelphia and it's in the tunnels of City Hall
mentions.locationEvidence: Named outright: 'the tunnels of City Hall' (0:05-0:07), 'City Hall in my City Philadelphia' (2:24-2:30), 'the tunnels of City Hall' again (3:45). The 'tunnels' are the four arched portals that lead from the street into the City Hall courtyard. This video never says which of the four he is in; his 2023 video (aimOhkdFXco) names the one facing Dilworth Plaza (west side) as the best.
mentions.notes: Regular-habit language is explicit: 'favorite place', 'you can photograph in this same mundane place over and over again' (0:43-0:47), 'the light that's consistent year round' (2:38), 'the best place for me to practice my street photography' (4:20-4:24). Same person and place as aimOhkdFXco; the 2023 video has the better haunt quote because it states a daily walk-through and names the specific portal.

mentions.place: City Hall tunnels (pedestrian archways through Philadelphia City Hall, Broad & Market)
mentions.speaker: Dante Sisofo
mentions.quote: and I just find it so nice when I can make these minimalist compositions of this boy carrying the newspaper
mentions.locationEvidence: He is standing in the tunnel while talking ('as you can see through the the LCD screen as people enter this patch of light here', 0:07-0:11) and reacts to a frame just made there. Which portal is not stated in this video.
mentions.notes: Frames demonstrably made on camera: the boy with the newspaper and medal (0:47-0:59), silhouettes 'as you can see in in in the photograph' (3:31-3:38), and a self-portrait ('maybe I got it maybe I didn't sometimes yeah I did', 4:31-4:35). Shooting vertical and horizontal on the Ricoh throughout.
